name: Mattithiah
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Mattithiah had the set office over the things made in the pans, and the Kohathites prepared the shewbread every sabbath, showing all the offices these brethren held.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 9: The Returned Inhabitants and Their Offices
